drill: scripts/phase27-dr.test.mjs — standard PostgreSQL tools only (pg_dump/pg_restore/pg_basebackup/psql inside the source and PITR containers); no custom backup format, scheduler, or encryption

commands.backup: pg_dump -F c (custom format) via the source container
commands.restore: pg_restore --no-owner --no-privileges into the confirmed disposable target database
commands.migration: applyEnterpriseMigrations (existing runner) applied 004/005 over the raw-001-003 legacy schema
commands.rollback: pg_restore of the pre-upgrade backup into a fresh database (disposable-environment rollback rehearsal; production prefers roll-forward repair)
commands.pitr: pg_basebackup + archived WAL replay to recovery_target_time between two known writes

guards: guard: source and target databases differ
guard: target looks like a disposable restore db
guard: sufficient free space on the artifact dir

rollback.lossWindow: writes between the pre-upgrade backup and the rollback restore are lost (restore is the last resort; forward repair is preferred)

pitr.note: RPO/RTO measured in this disposable environment; managed backup, encryption, and cross-region replication are operator-owned and NOT claimed
